The percentage reduction is calculated as:

$$
\text{Percentage reduction} = \left( \frac{\text{Original latency} - \text{New latency}}{\text{Original latency}} \right) \times 100
$$

$$
= \left( \frac{800 - 600}{800} \right) \times 100 = \left( \frac{200}{800} \right) \times 100 = 25\%
$$

$$
\boxed{25%}
$$
